# Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) 한국어

> Universal Commerce Protocol(UCP) 공식 문서의 비공식 한국어 번역입니다. UCP는 AI 에이전트가 사용자를 대신해 상품 탐색부터 결제까지 커머스 작업을 안전하고 프라이버시를 지키며 수행할 수 있도록 하는 개방형 표준입니다.


This is the documentation directory for the Universal Commerce Protocol
(UCP), an open standard that enables gen AI agents to safely, securely,
and privately execute commerce actions (i.e., discovering, buying) on
behalf of users.
### Technical Specification Indices (llms.txt)
For raw, LLM-optimized indices of our versioned technical
specifications:
- [Latest Stable UCP
  Specification Index](https://ucp.dev/latest/llms.txt):
  Standardized specifications for production deployments.
- [UCP Specification Index
  (2026-08-25)](https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/llms.txt):
  Stable spec release version 2026-08-25.
- [UCP Specification Index
  (2026-04-08)](https://ucp.dev/2026-04-08/llms.txt):
  Stable spec release version 2026-04-08.
- [UCP Specification Index
  (2026-01-23)](https://ucp.dev/2026-01-23/llms.txt):
  Stable spec release version 2026-01-23.
- [UCP Specification Index
  (2026-01-11)](https://ucp.dev/2026-01-11/llms.txt):
  Stable spec release version 2026-01-11.


## Overview

- [홈](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/index.md): High-level architecture, core value propositions, and structural capabilities of the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) as a common language for commerce agents.
- [핵심 개념](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/documentation/core-concepts/index.md): Fundamental UCP abstractions, including the decoupled separation of capabilities, extensions, services, and the decentralized protocol negotiation model.
- [UCP와 AP2](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/documentation/ucp-and-ap2/index.md): Integration patterns with the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) to facilitate secure, agent-mediated checkout commitments and cryptographically signed mandates.
- [로드맵](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/documentation/roadmap/index.md): Future development and planned capabilities of UCP.
- [스키마 작성](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/documentation/schema-authoring/index.md): Comprehensive guidelines and JSON Schema design conventions when authoring or extending UCP schemas, including strict versioning and registry patterns.
- [버전 관리](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/versioning/index.md): UCP's strict date-based versioning policy (YYYY-MM-DD) and compatibility guidelines for managing breaking changes and release branches.
- [공지](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/documentation/announcements/index.md): General announcements, release notes, and community updates for the Universal Commerce Protocol.
- [기여하기](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/documentation/contributing/index.md): Guidelines for contributing to the Universal Commerce Protocol, including the Enhancement Proposal (EP) lifecycle, capability maturity levels, and repository workflows.

## Specification

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/overview/index.md): Master technical specification of UCP, discovery mechanisms, secure transports, capability negotiation, and error taxonomies.
- [시작하기](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/getting-started/index.md): Step-by-step developer guide for building a UCP checkout server in Python (FastAPI) or Node.js (Express).
- [용어집](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/glossary/index.md): Definitions of the protocol, commerce, payment, regulatory, and standards terms and acronyms used throughout the specification, including Capability, Extension, Action, Platform, Business, and Merchant of Record.

## Common

- [신원 연결(Identity Linking)](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/identity-linking/index.md): User authentication via the Identity Linking Capability, specifying direct B2C/B2B OAuth 2.0 flows (with PKCE and RFC 9207) to unlock personalized commerce data.
- [로열티](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/extensions/loyalty/index.md): Loyalty Extension, enabling high-fidelity member benefit recognition during catalog, cart, and checkout by defining schemas for memberships, tiers, benefits, and reward earning forecasts while managing provisional eligibility claims and enforcing data-minimization privacy rules.

## Location Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/location/index.md): Core Location Capability, detailing physical Location discovery, spatial relations, item availability, operating hours, and amenities.
- [검색](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/location/search/index.md): Location discovery via the Location Search capability, specifying text queries, spatial relations, and structured filters.
- [조회](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/location/lookup/index.md): Direct Location retrieval via the Location Lookup capability, specifying identifiers and optional spatial relations and filters.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/location/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for the Location Capability, detailing search and lookup endpoints with JSON payload examples.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/location/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for the Location Capability, mapping discovery operations to JSON-RPC tools with metadata validation rules.

## Ask Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/ask/index.md): Core Ask Capability (`dev.ucp.common.ask`), defining natural-language Q&A about a business's resources, policies, and services, grounded in any business resource across verticals and returning a read-only, non-authoritative answer with optional related links.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/ask/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for the Ask Capability on the Common service, detailing the `POST /ask` endpoint, request and response payloads, and the non-authoritative answer contract.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/common/ask/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for the Ask Capability on the Common service, mapping the `ask_business` tool to JSON-RPC with metadata validation rules and related-link conventions.

## Message Signatures

- [서명](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/signatures/index.md): Implementation details for RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and RFC 9530 Content-Digests to achieve secure, transport-agnostic request authentication and replay protection.

## Checkout Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/checkout/index.md): Core Checkout Capability specifications detailing session state lifecycles, totals calculation rules, and buyer input validation severity states.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/checkout/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for Checkout operations, specifying standard headers, API endpoints, status codes, and payload structures.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/checkout/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for Checkout operations, mapping UCP capabilities to JSON-RPC tools with agent metadata rules.
- [A2A](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/checkout/a2a/index.md): Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A) binding for Checkout Capability, detailing transport discovery, agent card profile advertisement, and message negotiation flows.
- [임베디드 프로토콜](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/embedded-protocol/index.md): Core Embedded Protocol (EP) transport binding, defining message formats, handshake patterns, communication channels, security constraints, and shared error handling structures for iframe/webview integrations.
- [임베디드](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/checkout/embedded/index.md): Embedded Checkout Protocol (ECP) specification, detailing per-session delegation negotiation, URL parameters, native UI event mappings, W3C Payment Request conceptual alignment, and core lifecycle messages.

## Cart Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/cart/index.md): Pre-purchase Cart Capability, detailing item collection, state modification, and seamless transition handoff to active checkout sessions.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/cart/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for Cart operations, including endpoints for session creation, modification, retrieval, and cancellation.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/cart/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for Cart operations, mapping item management to JSON-RPC tools for AI shopping agents.
- [임베디드 프로토콜](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/embedded-protocol/index.md): Core Embedded Protocol (EP) transport binding, defining message formats, handshake patterns, communication channels, security constraints, and shared error handling structures for iframe/webview integrations.
- [임베디드](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/cart/embedded/index.md): Embedded Cart Protocol (ECaP), enabling secure, cross-origin iframe communication and synchronized event states between platform agents and business websites.

## Permalink Capability

- [퍼머링크(Permalink) 기능](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/permalink/index.md): Browser-addressable shopping intent capability, defining endpoint discovery, compact item paths, open query initialization fields, and redirect resolution.

## Catalog Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/catalog/index.md): Core Catalog Capability, detailing high-level product discovery models, variant structures, merchant attribution, and real-time pricing context.
- [검색](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/catalog/search/index.md): Product discovery via the Search Catalog capability, specifying text queries, category browsing, and multi-attribute filtering contracts.
- [조회](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/catalog/lookup/index.md): Direct item retrieval via the Lookup Catalog capability, specifying variant resolution logic, batch identifiers, and interactive option selection.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/catalog/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for the Catalog Capability, detailing search, batch lookup, and product detail endpoints with JSON payload examples.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/catalog/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for the Catalog Capability, mapping discovery operations to JSON-RPC tools with metadata validation rules.

## Ask Capability (Shopping)

- [문의(Ask) 기능](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/ask/index.md): Thin integration guide mapping Shopping concerns (products, carts, checkouts, orders) onto their owning structured capabilities while using the Common Ask capability unchanged.

## Order Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/order/index.md): Post-purchase tracking via the Order Capability, detailing line item updates, fulfillment expectations, shipment events, adjustments, and webhook-based status updates.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/order/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for the Order Capability, detailing endpoints, HTTP headers, payload schemas, and error structures.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/order/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for the Order Capability, detailing the JSON-RPC tool interface and parameters for fetching order states.

## Shopping Extensions

- [풀필먼트](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/extensions/fulfillment/index.md): Fulfillment extension for checkouts, defining delivery methods, pickup destinations, and method-agnostic UI rendering contracts.
- [할인](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/extensions/discount/index.md): Discount Extension, covering discount code discovery, applied discounts, allocation method stacking orders, rejected code message handling, and automatic or provisional eligibility promotions.
- [구매자 동의](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/extensions/buyer-consent/index.md): Buyer Consent Extension, defining data schemas for transmitting buyer privacy choices (analytics, marketing, personalization) to assist with privacy compliance (CCPA/GDPR).

## Lodging Booking Capability

- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/lodging/booking/index.md): Core Booking Capability specification detailing necessary data exchange and payment processing for finalizing reservations on a pre-selected room inventory.
- [REST](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/lodging/booking/rest/index.md): HTTP REST transport binding for Booking operations, including endpoints for session creation, modification, retrieval, and cancellation.
- [MCP](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/lodging/booking/mcp/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport binding for Booking operations, mapping reservation session management to JSON-RPC tools for AI booking agents.

## Lodging Extensions

- [취소 정책](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/lodging/extensions/cancellation-policy/index.md): Lodging Cancellation Policy Extension, defining the dev.ucp.lodging.policy.cancellation type on the core policies[] primitive with a machine-readable refundability classification and a human-readable penalty schedule for lodging reservations.

## Payment

- [AP2 위임(Mandates) 확장](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/extensions/ap2-mandates/index.md): AP2 Mandates Extension, detailing secure, cryptographically bound checkout commitments (using SD-JWT+kb digital credentials and detached JWS signatures) between business, platform, and payment providers.
- [개요](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/extensions/authentication/index.md): Payment Authentication Extension, defining negotiation, payment-handler association, lifecycle, trust, and embedded notifications for standard payment authentication Actions.
- [기기 데이터 수집](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/extensions/actions/device-data-collection/index.md): Standard Action type for running invisible device-data collection surfaces during payment processing.
- [3DS 챌린지](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/extensions/actions/three-ds-challenge/index.md): Standard Action type for presenting buyer-facing 3DS challenges.
- [분할 결제 확장](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/extensions/split-payments/index.md): Split Payments Extension, defining multiple payment instrument allocation, settlement rules, and amount distribution across payment handlers.
- [결제 조건(Terms) 확장](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/extensions/terms/index.md): Payment Terms Extension, enabling checkout payment schedules for immediate and deferred payments such as deposits, installments, and lodging balance-at-check-in flows.
- [가이드](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/guide/index.md): Architectural framework and standard vocabulary for specifying UCP payment handlers, covering configuration declarations and transaction execution.
- [템플릿](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/template/index.md): Standard Markdown template and integration checklist when authoring new UCP payment handler specifications.
- [토큰화 가이드](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/tokenization/index.md): Shared API, security requirements, and lifecycle policies (single-use, TTL, session-scoped) for building compliant tokenization payment handlers.
- [프로세서 토크나이저](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/examples/processor-tokenizer-payment-handler/index.md): Concrete payment handler example utilizing a 'Tokenize to Process' flow, where a single enterprise vault or PSP tokenizes credentials and resolves them internally.
- [플랫폼 토크나이저](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/examples/platform-tokenizer-payment-handler/index.md): Concrete payment handler example utilizing a 'Platform-as-Tokenizer' flow, where a platform's wallet generates tokens and hosts a secure detokenization endpoint.
- [암호화된 자격 증명](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/payment/examples/encrypted-credential-payment-handler/index.md): Concrete payment handler example utilizing a 'Direct Encryption' flow, where a platform encrypts payment data with a business's public key for local decryption.

## Reference & Tooling

- [레퍼런스](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/reference/index.md): Complete reference directory of all core UCP, type, and extension JSON schemas, including platform/business profiles and metadata objects.
- [플레이그라운드](https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/ucp-ko/draft/draft/specification/shopping/playground/index.md): Interactive, browser-based UCP Playground simulator for walking through step-by-step checkout sessions, payment handling, and backend webhooks.
